name: neuronsim
description: Interactive, model-driven simulations that teach how excitable cells signal: a neuron (receive → integrate → fire → propagate → transmit) and a skeletal muscle fibre (shock → impulse → Ca²⁺ → force → tetanus, then the neuromuscular junction); the heart and circulation (HeartSim, BIO 142); and hormones and feedback (EndoSim, BIO 142).
